proposals.evidence: DEDR764 explicitly gives Brahui ē/ēd ‘that’, the most remote demonstrative. Survey ae is compared with this ē-series, preserving its vowel spelling rather than confusing it with the Pashto-influenced dā-series in DEDR1. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
